roget-0341.scope: Oceans — five named oceans within one connected global ocean; applies to Saltwater area.

roget-0343.scope: Lakes — about 117 million with area at least 0.002 km², the GLOWABO satellite inventory (2014), excluding Greenland and Antarctica. A size-threshold estimate relevant to Standing-water area; lakes are not necessarily freshwater.
roget-0343.interpretation: Count is for lakes only; the thesaurus heading also covers gulfs.

roget-0346.scope: Islands — 340,686 mapped marine islands, calculated from 21,818 larger than 1 km² and 318,868 at most 1 km² in the USGS-described 30 m satellite inventory (2014 imagery, 2020 publication). Excludes its five continental mainlands; map resolution and shoreline rules limit completeness.

roget-0560.scope: Human languages — 7,170 living languages, Ethnologue's 29th edition (2026), as reported by Wikipedia. Language-versus-dialect boundaries depend on the catalogue; extinct and constructed languages are outside this total.

roget-node-23.scope: Natural number, Integer, and Rational number — each countably infinite, cardinality ℵ₀.
Real number and Complex number — each uncountably infinite, cardinality of the continuum, 2^ℵ₀; a complex number is a pair of real numbers.
